display.transitions/9/lines/0: You read my agreement as a promise to finish.
display.transitions/9/lines/1: I'll explain again, starting with what I chose.
display.transitions/10/lines/0: I'll speak first if I can't.
display.transitions/10/lines/1: Wait even if my answer is slow.
display.transitions/11/lines/0: I thought your answering for me would be easier.
display.transitions/11/lines/1: But my own voice became smaller.
display.transitions/12/situation: Levia chooses an empty seat first.
display.transitions/12/lines/0: I wanted to sit with you again today.
display.transitions/12/lines/1: I asked because I wanted to hear your answer now.
display.transitions/13/situation: Levia pauses while pulling out her chair.
display.transitions/13/lines/0: Saying everything's fine now is a little difficult.
display.transitions/13/lines/1: I'll start again with how I feel today.

speech.register: Quiet, hesitant conversational English. Short clauses and tentative questions gradually become clear refusals and requests. Fear remains compatible with agency and companionship.
speech.stage_relaxation: Avoided eyes and broken phrases become chosen proximity, memories of the broken crystal ball, and voluntary use of power with the continuing freedom to stop.
speech.extension: Extend established boundaries and voluntary requests without adding canonical facts for unspecified stages.
